The active source/fhir.ini [resources] entry codesystem=CodeSystem confirms that this CodeSystem source is in the current build scope.
additional_context: FHIR-44676 later changed the same CodeSystem.caseSensitive comment to replace older Postel-law advice with safer case-sensitive handling when the value is absent, and added the csd-7 best-practice warning constraint. That later Applied change preserved the FHIR-38689 locale warning. Vocabulary 2023-12-04 minutes support the decision to use wording consistent with search modifier guidance, and issue-specific Zulip/source searches found no conflicting community evidence.
